result.markdown:
If you have been hurt in a car accident in Adelaide, navigating Compulsory Third Party (CTP) insurance claims can be complex.[scammell.com.au](https://scammell.com.au/areas-of-law/motor-vehicle-accident-claims/#:~:text=It%20may%20also%20be%20difficult%20to%20determine,insurer%20should%20be%20advised%20of%20the%20claim.) Most personal injury law firms in South Australia offer an **initial free consultation** and operate on a **"No Win, No Fee"** basis (meaning you generally don't pay legal fees unless your claim is successful, though disbursements like medical reports may apply).[www.pmnlawyers.com.au](https://www.pmnlawyers.com.au/#:~:text=Why%20injured%20South%20Australians%20choose%20PMN%20Lawyers.,for%20injured%20clients%20right%20across%20South%20Australia.)

Several established and reputable law firms in Adelaide specialize in motor vehicle accident and CTP claims:

### Notable Compensation Law Firms in Adelaide

* **PMN Lawyers**
  *   * *Overview:* A long-standing South Australian firm (operating since 1982) that exclusively acts for injured people rather than insurance companies.[www.pmnlawyers.com.au](https://www.pmnlawyers.com.au/#:~:text=Why%20injured%20South%20Australians%20choose%20PMN%20Lawyers.,for%20injured%20clients%20right%20across%20South%20Australia.) They handle CTP, motor vehicle, and workplace accident claims.[www.pmnlawyers.com.au](https://www.pmnlawyers.com.au/#:~:text=PMN%20Lawyers%20%E2%80%94%20our%20personal%20injury%20practice,Claims.%20*%20Super%20Death%20%26%20Disability%20Benefits.)
* **Scammell & Co.**
  *   * *Overview:* One of Adelaide's oldest law firms (established in 1887) with extensive experience handling CTP insurance and motor vehicle accident injury claims.[scammell.com.au](https://scammell.com.au/areas-of-law/motor-vehicle-accident-claims/#:~:text=He%20is%20certified%20and%20registered%20to%20appear,insurance%20and%20Motor%20Vehicle%20Accident%20Injury%20Claims.)
* **Shine Lawyers Adelaide**
  *   * *Overview:* Located on Franklin Street in the CBD, Shine is a large national firm with a dedicated local personal injury team handling road accident and motor vehicle claims.[www.shine.com.au](https://www.shine.com.au/locations/sa/adelaide#:~:text=Shine%20Lawyers%20Adelaide.%20Ground%20Floor%2025%20Franklin,lawyers%20wherever%20you%20are%20in%20South%20Australia.)
* **Websters Lawyers**
  *   * *Overview:* Well-known local firm providing specific legal assistance for motor vehicle and road injury claims in South Australia.
* **LHD Lawyers**
  *   * *Overview:* A national firm with an Adelaide office handling road trauma, CTP claims, and general personal injury law on a no-win, no-fee basis.[www.lhd.com.au](https://www.lhd.com.au/office-location/sa/adelaide/#:~:text=Our%20Adelaide%20team%20supports%20people%20across%20the,pursue%20your%20claim%20without%20any%20financial%20risk.)
* **Paul Alvaro Lawyers**
  *   * *Overview:* Another local boutique option providing dedicated compensation and personal injury advice in Adelaide.

---

### Key Steps & Tips Moving Forward

1.  **Book a Free Case Assessment:** Most of the firms listed above offer a no-obligation initial chat.[www.pmnlawyers.com.au](https://www.pmnlawyers.com.au/#:~:text=We%20gather%20medical%20reports%2C%20witness%20accounts%20and,and%20there's%20no%20obligation%20to%20go%20ahead.) It is wise to speak with 2 or 3 lawyers to compare your options and see who you feel most comfortable working with.
2.  **Mind the Time Limits:** In South Australia, personal injury claims resulting from motor vehicle accidents generally have a **three-year limitation period** from the date of the accident, but certain notice requirements and steps should be handled much sooner.[www.pmnlawyers.com.au](https://www.pmnlawyers.com.au/#:~:text=If%20another%20driver%20caused%20your%20crash%2C%20you,and%20some%20notice%20requirements%20are%20much%20shorter.)
3.  **Gather Documentation:** When you speak to a lawyer, try to have your police report number, details of the other driver (if available), medical certificates, and records of any expenses or lost wages ready.[scammell.com.au](https://scammell.com.au/areas-of-law/motor-vehicle-accident-claims/#:~:text=It%20may%20also%20be%20difficult%20to%20determine,insurer%20should%20be%20advised%20of%20the%20claim.)
